summary: If you heat ice, it melts.

If + Past Perfect, would have + V3
If I had studied, I would have passed.
لو كنت قد درست، لكنت نجحت.
If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
لو كنت قد درست الطب، لكنت طبيبًا الآن.
If + Past Simple, would have + V3
If I were more careful, I wouldn't have made that mistake yesterday.
لو كنت أكثر حذرًا، لما ارتكبت ذلك الخطأ أمس.
